tldr: 台股週三大漲約 663 點、漲幅 1.47%，重返 45,000 關卡，台積電漲 15 元至 2,415 元，半導體與金融領軍全面走高。
市場靜待輝達本週財報，其 AI 資本支出與資料中心展望，成為台灣半導體與 AI 硬體供應鏈的關鍵變數。
金管會政策動作不停，預告明年八項新制，並推動過渡措施減輕壽險型金控接軌 TIS 與 IFRS 17 的資本壓力。
總經面，AI 帶動出口使主計總處大幅上修今年成長預測、景氣續亮紅燈；國稅局並提醒繼承房地持有期間與農地遺產稅申報規定。
海外方面，美股在輝達財報前收盤震盪，財報優於預期、資料中心營收年增逾倍且財測強勁；金價創逾三個月新高，市場靜待沃許傑克遜霍爾首秀。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲 663 點、重返 45,000 關卡
items.title_en: TAIEX surges 663 points to reclaim 45,000 as chip heavyweights rally
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週三（8/26）開低走高，終場勁揚約 663 點、漲幅 1.47%，收在約 45,833 點，成交量約 8,042 億元。台積電上漲 15 元至 2,415 元，領軍半導體與金融股全面走高。指數強勢收復 45,000 大關，顯示市場風險偏好回升，投資人在美股一連串重大事件前積極布局，帶動量價齊揚、季線再獲支撐，短線多方氣勢轉強。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index opened lower but powered higher on Wednesday (Aug 26), closing up about 663 points, or 1.47%, at roughly 45,833 on turnover near NT$804 billion. TSMC added NT$15 to NT$2,415, leading a broad advance across semiconductors and financials. The strong reclaim of the 45,000 level reflected improving risk appetite as investors positioned ahead of a heavy run of US catalysts.

items.title_zh: 靜待輝達財報、AI 資本支出成關鍵變數
items.title_en: Market rides higher into Nvidia's quarterly earnings as AI capex remains the swing factor
items.summary_zh: 市場情緒受輝達（Nvidia）本週財報預期激勵，其資料中心需求與 AI 資本支出展望，將直接牽動台灣半導體與 AI 硬體供應鏈評價。台積電與封裝族群居核心地位，交易人視這份財報為短線最大催化劑，可能驗證或挑戰支撐台股反彈的 AI 主流領軍格局，也讓權值電子在財報公布前維持高度關注與資金布局。
items.summary_en: Sentiment was buoyed by anticipation of Nvidia's results due this week, whose data-centre demand and AI capital-expenditure guidance will directly shape valuations across Taiwan's semiconductor and AI hardware chain. With TSMC and packaging suppliers front and centre, traders treated the print as the near-term catalyst that could confirm or challenge the AI-led leadership theme underpinning the index's rebound.

items.title_zh: 大摩看好 2026 AI 半導體、點名記憶體與機櫃為瓶頸
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley stays bullish on 2026 AI semiconductors, flags memory and racks as bottlenecks
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利重申對 2026 年 AI 半導體循環的正面看法，認為供給瓶頸將出現在「特殊記憶體」與「伺服器機櫃」，而非台積電產能，並給出台積電、散熱與記憶體等多檔目標價。此觀點凸顯 AI 需求續撐先進邏輯、高頻寬記憶體與散熱供應鏈的結構性主流地位，帶動台廠中上游接單能見度延續，也讓相關族群評價與資金關注度維持高檔。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley reiterated a constructive view on the 2026 AI semiconductor cycle, arguing that supply constraints will emerge in specialty memory and server racks rather than in TSMC's wafer capacity. The brokerage set targets across TSMC, thermal-management and memory names, underscoring that AI-driven demand keeps advanced logic, high-bandwidth memory and cooling suppliers as the structural leadership across Taiwan's hardware ecosystem.

items.title_zh: AI 熱潮助攻、台積電成 2026 隱形贏家
items.title_en: TSMC emerges as 2026's quiet winner as AI lifts revenue growth toward 30%
items.summary_zh: 台積電被視為 AI 熱潮的關鍵受惠者，管理層預估 2026 全年營收成長上看約三成，並看好至 2029 年 AI 相關營收年複合成長率近 60%。積極擴充 2nm 與先進封裝產能，使資本支出向設備、載板與散熱供應鏈外溢，鞏固台灣在全球 AI 供應鏈的核心地位。此結構性趨勢支撐台廠中長期動能，也讓相關供應鏈接單與評價維持強勢，成為台股電子權值的重要引擎。
items.summary_en: TSMC is increasingly seen as a key beneficiary of the AI boom, with management guiding full-year 2026 revenue growth toward roughly 30% and projecting an AI-related revenue compound annual growth rate near 60% through 2029. Aggressive 2nm and advanced-packaging ramp-ups cascade capex through equipment, substrate and cooling suppliers, cementing Taiwan's position as a core node in the global AI supply chain.
items.source_url: https://sunmedia.tw/news/technology/1776988360-台積電成2026年「隱形贏家」：AI熱潮助攻營收年增三成

items.title_zh: 金管會預告明年 8 項新制、壽險業迎大轉型
items.title_en: FSC previews eight new systems for 2026, pushing life insurers toward a full transformation
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告明年將有八項重大新制上路，推動壽險業全面轉型，以接軌 IFRS 17 與新一代清償能力制度。相關新制涵蓋財報、資本與揭露規範，促使保險業提升資產負債品質、強化風險管理紀律，並牽動壽險業競爭格局與資本規劃。此舉為業者長期體質改善鋪路，也讓投資人更能比較各公司財務結構與經營成果，成為金融族群後續重要的政策觀察主軸。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission has flagged eight major new rules taking effect next year that will drive life insurers toward a comprehensive transformation as they converge on IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime. The package spans financial-reporting, capital and disclosure requirements, nudging insurers toward cleaner balance sheets and more disciplined risk management, and reshaping the sector's competitive and capital-planning landscape.

items.title_zh: 接軌 TIS 過渡措施、壽險型金控資本大減壓
items.title_en: Transition measures ease capital pressure for life-insurance financial holdings ahead of TIS
items.summary_zh: 為協助保險業平順接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS）與 IFRS 17，金管會過渡措施可望大幅減輕多家壽險型金控的資本壓力，部分業者的資本適足率申報得以延後。此舉為壽險業爭取重建資本緩衝與強化資產負債配置的時間，避免財報與資本結構出現劇烈波動，也讓相關金控在轉軌期間維持經營彈性，牽動壽險族群的資本規劃與市場評價。
items.summary_en: To smooth the sector's convergence with the new Taiwan Insurance Solvency (TIS) framework and IFRS 17, the FSC's transitional measures are set to substantially relieve capital pressure at several life-insurance-heavy financial holding companies, with a number of firms able to defer capital-adequacy reporting. The relief buys insurers time to rebuild capital buffers and manage asset-liability matching without abrupt disruption to their balance sheets.

items.title_zh: 銀行看好私募與家族辦公室、籲擴大另類資產布局
items.title_en: Banks urge wider alternative-asset build-out and deeper cross-border wealth services
items.summary_zh: 在 2026 亞資高峰論壇上，銀行業者看好私募市場與家族辦公室，呼籲業界擴大另類資產布局、深化跨境財富管理服務。業者指出，台灣基金與保險商品已相當成熟，但相較國際私人銀行仍缺乏私募股權、私募債權、避險基金及外部資產管理（EAM）等另類投資，凸顯高資產與家族辦公室服務的結構性商機，也為國內財管業者拓展跨境與另類商品指出方向。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Asian asset-management forum, banking executives voiced optimism on private markets and family offices, urging the industry to broaden alternative-asset allocation and deepen cross-border wealth-management services. They noted that while Taiwan's funds and insurance products are mature, the market still lacks alternatives such as private equity, private credit, hedge funds and external asset-manager mandates, pointing to a structural opportunity for high-net-worth and family-office services.

items.title_zh: 超高資產客群境外配置近標配、需求轉向整合式財管
items.title_en: Offshore allocation becomes standard for Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth as needs turn integrated
items.summary_zh: 台灣超高資產客群洞察顯示，客戶需求由單一商品轉向整合式財富管理；進入十億超高資產層級後，境外資產配置近乎標配（約 86%），資產配置深度明顯拉高。財富傳承已不只是資產移轉，更重視家族價值與治理機制延續，促使銀行推出創新信託與整合式顧問服務，以掌握此一快速成長客群，帶動私人銀行與信託業務成為財管競爭的關鍵戰場。
items.summary_en: Wealth insights on Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth clients show demand shifting from single products toward integrated wealth management, with offshore asset allocation now near-standard—around 86%—once households enter the billion-dollar tier, and allocation depth rising markedly. Succession has evolved beyond asset transfer toward preserving family values and governance, prompting banks to roll out innovative trust structures and holistic advisory to capture this fast-growing segment.

items.title_zh: 繼承合建分屋可併計被繼承人持有期間、房地合一 2.0 稅負差很大
items.title_en: Inherited jointly-built housing can combine the decedent's land holding period under House-Land Tax 2.0
items.summary_zh: 國稅局提醒，個人出售 105 年 1 月 1 日以後繼承取得、被繼承人自建、合建或都更分得之房屋，持有期間可併計被繼承人的土地持有期間。由於房地合一 2.0 對短期持有課以較重稅率，正確併計繼承的持有期間，往往能讓後續出售適用較低稅率、明顯降低實質稅負，攸關繼承人處分不動產的稅務規劃與現金流，民眾申報前宜留意持有期間認定。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's tax authorities reminded taxpayers that when selling a house acquired through inheritance on or after Jan 1, 2016—including self-built, joint-build or urban-renewal apportioned property—the holding period may be combined with the decedent's land holding period. Because the House-Land Unified Income Tax (房地合一 2.0) applies steeply higher rates on short holdings, correctly aggregating the inherited holding period can materially lower the effective tax on a subsequent sale.

items.title_zh: 5 年內繼承作農業使用農地仍須計入遺產總額
items.title_en: Farmland inherited within five years must still be included in the gross estate for tax
items.summary_zh: 國稅局提醒，被繼承人遺有 5 年內繼承、且作農業使用之農業用地，申報遺產稅時仍應計入遺產總額，並檢附農業主管機關核發之農業用地作農業使用證明書。此提醒凸顯即使農地享有農用相關優惠，仍有申報義務；若忽略 5 年內的連續繼承情形，恐遭補稅甚至加計處罰，攸關農地繼承家庭的遺產稅申報正確性與稅務風險控管，民眾辦理繼承時宜先釐清農地來源與使用狀態。
items.summary_en: The tax bureau reminded heirs that agricultural land put to agricultural use that was itself inherited within the previous five years must be included in the total estate value when filing estate tax, supported by an agricultural-use certificate issued by the competent authority. The reminder underscores that even farmland benefiting from agricultural-use exemptions carries reporting obligations, and overlooking successive inheritances within five years can trigger back taxes and penalties.

items.title_zh: AI 帶動出口、主計總處上修今年經濟成長
items.title_en: AI-led exports drive Taiwan's 2026 growth forecast sharply higher
items.summary_zh: 主計總處受惠 AI 需求爆發與台美關稅不確定性消除，大幅上修 2026 年經濟成長預測，預估出口年增率強勁、每人 GDP 續攀高。此次上修反映 AI 基礎建設熱潮持續驅動出口引擎，惟成長動能高度集中於半導體與科技供應鏈，經濟復甦的產業廣度仍為政策關注焦點。下半年能否由「AI 集中成長」擴散至多元產業共同受惠，將牽動內需與就業表現，也是政策著力方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's statistics agency has revised its 2026 economic-growth outlook markedly higher on the back of surging AI demand and easing US tariff uncertainty, with exports projected to expand strongly year on year and per-capita GDP forecast to climb further. The upgrade reflects how the AI infrastructure boom continues to power the export engine, though it also concentrates growth in the semiconductor and tech supply chain, keeping the breadth of the recovery a key policy watch-point.

items.title_zh: 景氣對策信號續亮紅燈、AI 需求撐起製造動能
items.title_en: Business-cycle signal stays "red" as AI demand lifts manufacturing
items.summary_zh: 台灣景氣對策信號綜合判斷分數維持「紅燈」，代表景氣熱絡，主要受惠 AI 相關需求強勁，帶動製造業銷售與加班工時增加，製造業銷售量指數由黃紅燈轉為紅燈。持續亮紅燈凸顯動能高度集中於科技與出口部門；政策面則思考如何將成長由 AI 擴散至跨產業數位升級，讓下半年復甦更具廣度，避免景氣熱度過度倚賴單一族群，牽動後續貨幣與產業政策節奏。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's monitoring indicator has stayed at a "red" flash—signalling a heated economy—driven by strong AI-related demand that has lifted manufacturing sales and overtime hours, with the manufacturing sales index shifting from yellow-red to red. The sustained red signal highlights robust momentum concentrated in the tech and export sectors, while policymakers weigh how to broaden the expansion beyond AI toward wider cross-industry digital upgrading in the second half.

items.title_zh: 台媒：輝達財報、聯準會論壇與地緣政治主導本週美股
items.title_en: Taiwan media: Nvidia earnings, the Fed forum and geopolitics set the tone for US stocks this week
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體指出，本週美股走向繫於輝達季度財報、聯準會主席沃許（Warsh）傑克遜霍爾（Jackson Hole）首秀，以及升溫的地緣政治風險。報導將輝達財報視為單一最大風險事件，甚至形容「威力甚於傑克遜霍爾」，其 AI 資本支出與資料中心展望被認為將決定 AI 行情能否延續，並連動台灣半導體供應鏈評價與資金流向，成為台股投資人跨市場布局的關鍵觀察點。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese financial media highlighted that this week's US market direction hinges on Nvidia's quarterly results, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole debut and simmering geopolitical risk. Reports framed the Nvidia print as the single biggest risk event—dubbed "more powerful than Jackson Hole"—with its AI capex and data-centre guidance seen as decisive for the AI-driven rally and, by extension, Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain.
items.source_url: https://sunmedia.tw/news/finance/1787526814-輝達財報、聯準會論壇與地緣政治牽動美股本週動向

items.title_zh: 台媒：殖利率壓抑科技股、資金避險轉進黃金
items.title_en: Taiwan media: yields pressure tech while gold rallies on tail-risk hedging
items.summary_zh: 台灣分析指出，美債殖利率高檔壓抑科技股評價，部分資金轉進黃金與原物料以對沖尾部風險，金價一度大漲逾 2%。相關報導認為「輝達決定基本面、傑克遜霍爾決定本益比」，將 AI 財報與聯準會溝通的交互作用，視為左右全球風險偏好的關鍵變數。月底前市場在科技股、黃金與債市之間審慎換手，也牽動台股電子與資金板塊的短線輪動節奏與方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese analysts noted that elevated Treasury yields have weighed on technology valuations, pushing some capital toward gold and commodities as a hedge against tail risks, with bullion jumping more than 2%. Coverage argued that Nvidia's results set the fundamentals while Warsh's Jackson Hole message sets the multiple, framing the interplay of AI earnings and Fed communication as the swing factor for global risk appetite heading into month-end.

items.title_zh: 美股收盤震盪、輝達盤後財報優於預期勁揚（2026-08-26）
items.title_en: US stocks close mixed as investors await Nvidia; shares jump after the bell on earnings beat (2026-08-26)
items.summary_zh: 美股週三震盪，PCE 通膨僵固加上輝達財報倒數，標普 500 幾乎持平、道瓊約跌 0.2%。輝達盤中一度跌逾 1%，盤後因優於預期並看好後續營收成長而勁揚逾 4%。Meta 因同意以約 167 億美元和解社群媒體成癮訴訟而走高，市場焦點集中於 AI 龍頭財報對後市方向的指引。
items.summary_en: US stocks traded mixed on Wednesday as sticky PCE inflation and the countdown to Nvidia's report kept the S&P 500 little changed and the Dow down about 0.2%. Nvidia slipped more than 1% during the session but rallied over 4% after the close after beating expectations and guiding to strong revenue growth. Meta rose after agreeing to a roughly $16.7 billion settlement of a social-media addiction trial.

items.title_zh: 輝達財報與財測雙優、資料中心營收年增逾倍（2026-08-26）
items.title_en: Nvidia beats on earnings and guidance as data-centre revenue nearly doubles (2026-08-26)
items.summary_zh: 輝達公布淨利約 596.9 億美元、每股約 2.46 美元，資料中心營收約 890 億美元、年增逾一倍，並預估本季營收約 1,080 億美元（上下 2%），高於華爾街約 1,040 億美元預期。公司表示財測未計入來自中國的資料中心銷售，凸顯即使面臨出口限制，AI 基礎建設需求仍強勁支撐晶片龍頭營運與成長動能。
items.summary_en: Nvidia reported net income of about $59.69 billion, or $2.46 per share, with data-centre revenue of roughly $89 billion, up more than twofold year on year, and guided to about $108 billion in current-quarter sales, plus or minus 2%—above Wall Street's roughly $104 billion estimate. The company said its outlook assumes no data-centre sales from China, underscoring how AI infrastructure demand continues to drive the chipmaker despite export restrictions.

items.title_zh: 傑克遜霍爾前夕：美元與債市繃緊神經等待沃許首秀（2026-08-26）
items.title_en: Dollar and bond markets 'on edge' ahead of Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech (2026-08-26)
items.summary_zh: 市場屏息等待聯準會主席沃許週五在傑克遜霍爾的首場演說，策略師警告若令市場失望，美元恐面臨延續性賣壓。沃許「少即是多」的溝通風格已擾動債市與投資人信心，加上財政部可能動用一般帳戶資金支應買回公債的傳聞，使利率預期出現多空交錯，牽動今年餘下的政策路徑與全球資金流向判斷。
items.summary_en: Markets braced for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole debut on Friday, with strategists warning the US dollar was vulnerable to an extended sell-off if he disappoints. Warsh's less-is-more communication style has unsettled bond markets and investor confidence, and reports that the Treasury could tap its General Account to fund buybacks added to the crosscurrents shaping rate expectations for the rest of the year.

items.title_zh: 黃金創逾三個月新高、受惠美元走弱與買回計畫（2026-08-25）
items.title_en: Gold hits a more-than-three-month high on a softer dollar and buyback plans (2026-08-25)
items.summary_zh: 金價升至逾三個月高點，受惠美元走弱與財政部公債買回計畫的傳聞，投資人聚焦美國關鍵通膨數據與沃許即將登場的傑克遜霍爾演說。分析師指出，若沃許態度偏鷹恐終結漲勢，偏鴿意外則對金價極為有利，使黃金成為市場衡量聯準會政策預期變化的溫度計，月底前續為避險資金關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Gold climbed to its highest in over three months as a subdued US dollar and reports of Treasury bond-buyback plans lent support, with investors focused on key US inflation data and Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole speech. Analysts said a hawkish message could halt the rally while a dovish surprise would be strongly bullish, positioning bullion as a barometer of shifting Fed expectations into month-end.
